mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_feedback (session_id, user_id, result, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{feedback.sessionId}, #{feedback.userId}, #{resultValue}, #{feedback.createTime}, #{feedback.updateTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), handle_status = IF(result <> VALUES(result), 0, handle_status), handler_id = IF(result <> VALUES(result), NULL, handler_id), handle_time = IF(result <> VALUES(result), NULL, handle_time), result = VALUES(result), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, result, handle_status, handler_id, handle_time, create_time, update_time FROM ai_chat_feedback WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_feedback_retest SET execution_status = 4, processing_time = NULL, last_error = 'feedback result changed', update_time = #{now} WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId} AND (execution_status IN (0, 1) OR (execution_status = 2 AND review_result IS NULL))
